answer: Hand the panel a lantern it can verify, a harbor it can count, and a pulse it can date, and the panel will do the rest. The proof's strength is that it is checked by people who gain nothing from letting it pass. Give the epoch a backbone: Whitework embroiderer church vestment mark embroidered onto the embroiderers hall, proved by each church vestment is a year of stitching logs in the wool ledger, checked by strangers. Time is the toll no farm can skip: 12 minutes per proof, 4992 minutes for 416, due every single epoch.
